apps/web/app/[username]/[slug]/PreserveS.offline: It never fetches: it paints the shared SmartLink loading shell (Loading) and hands the hop to location.replace, a full navigation whose offline failure the browser shows on its own error page, outside this component.

apps/web/app/app/(shell)/DashboardShellC.loading: DashboardShellContent is an async server component awaited inside the shell layout's Suspense boundary, so it never renders a loading frame of its own; that fallback is shell-route-skeleton.tsx, which carries the loading stories.
apps/web/app/app/(shell)/DashboardShellC.offline: DashboardShellContent runs only on the server for a request, so browser connectivity never reaches it. A server read that stalls past 10 seconds returns the PageErrorState branch, asserted in DashboardShellContent.test.tsx.
apps/web/app/app/(shell)/DashboardShellC.long-content: Its only copy of its own is the fixed workspace-load PageErrorState message; everything else it renders is route children passed through, which certify their own long-content states.
apps/web/app/app/(shell)/DashboardShellC.rtl-overflow: Its only copy of its own is the fixed English workspace-load message; text direction comes from the route children it passes through, which certify their own right-to-left states.

apps/web/app/app/(shell)/chat/DeferredJo.error: The wrapper only defers loading JovieChat; a chunk that fails to load throws to the chat route's error.tsx boundary, and every chat error is JovieChat's own state.
apps/web/app/app/(shell)/chat/DeferredJo.long-content: The wrapper renders no text of its own: the skeleton has no copy and the mounted chat is JovieChat, which owns message length.
apps/web/app/app/(shell)/chat/DeferredJo.offline: The wrapper never fetches or mutates; the only network it causes is the chunk request, whose failure is the error boundary's, and offline sends are JovieChat's.
apps/web/app/app/(shell)/chat/DeferredJo.rtl-overflow: The wrapper renders no text or input of its own; the composer and messages are JovieChat's. The detector matched words in its doc comment.

apps/web/app/app/(shell)/shell-route-ske.empty: resolveShellRouteSkeleton maps a pathname to a route skeleton and renders no data collection; the detector matched the imported ReleaseTableSkeleton and LinksRouteSkeleton names. An unknown path returns undefined so the layout keeps its generic AppShellSkeleton.
apps/web/app/app/(shell)/shell-route-ske.offline: Route skeletons paint as the shell layout's Suspense fallback before any request runs. The resolver never fetches or submits, so connectivity cannot reach it.

apps/web/app/desktop-auth/DesktopAuthCli.permission-denied: The handoff has no gated action, role or entitlement input; the detector matched role='img' on the QR tile. apps/web/app/desktop-auth/DesktopAuthCod.long-content: maxLength 9 caps the code at XXXX-XXXX and every label in the form is fixed product copy; the longest status copy renders in the owner's DesktopAuthStatus line (DesktopAuthClient's LongCopyPhoneSignIn story).

apps/web/app/desktop-auth/DesktopAuthSha.permission-denied: The heading, status line and cancel button have no gated action or permission input; cancelling is always allowed. The detector matched role='status' on the live status line.

apps/web/app/desktop-auth/MacCinematicSu.empty: MacCinematicSurface is a visual shell around one handoff child and takes no collection; the detector matched the place-items-center class on its main landmark.

apps/web/components/atoms/AnimatedIconSw.empty: AnimatedIconSwap renders exactly one keyed icon and never a collection; the detector matched the items-center class.
apps/web/components/atoms/AnimatedIconSw.long-content: AnimatedIconSwap wraps one icon in a box its caller sizes and lays out no text; every caller passes a lucide glyph, so there is no content to overflow (the detector matched the children prop).
apps/web/components/atoms/AnimatedIconSw.rtl-overflow: AnimatedIconSwap lays out no text and has no start or end placement, only one centred icon, so writing direction changes nothing it renders.

apps/web/components/atoms/AppIconButton..empty: AppIconButton wraps one icon child and takes no collection; the detector matched the items-center class in APP_CONTROL_BUTTON_CLASS.
apps/web/components/atoms/AppIconButton..partial: Its required accessible label is its only data; the optional tooltip label and shortcut are presentation, and a tooltip label without a shortcut is the existing WithTooltip story, so nothing can be partially present.
apps/web/components/atoms/AppIconButton..long-content: The control is a fixed 28px or 32px icon square; its label is announced through aria-label rather than rendered, and tooltip text layout belongs to TooltipShortcut, so no content can overflow the button.
apps/web/components/atoms/AppIconButton..rtl-overflow: The control is a symmetric icon square with no text or inline-direction classes and its tooltip opens below it, so it renders the same under dir='rtl'; mirroring a directional glyph is the caller's choice of child icon.

apps/web/components/atoms/ArtworkFrame.t.long-content: ArtworkFrame renders no text of its own: children is one square media slot clipped by overflow-hidden at the size the caller sets, so its content cannot grow; the detector matched the children prop.

apps/web/components/atoms/BrandLogo.tsx.permission-denied: BrandLogo only draws the brand mark and has no permission input or gated action; the detector matched role='img' on the svg.

apps/web/components/atoms/DotBadge.tsx.partial: label and variant are required, and size, title and className are presentation options, so the badge has no data that can be partially present. LongContent and Rtl cover the label's limits; DotBadge.test.tsx covers the title.

apps/web/components/atoms/DspLogo.tsx.partial: DspLogo takes one required provider key and draws that platform's fixed glyph and name together; its optional props (className, height) are styling with defaults, so nothing can be partially present, and an unmapped provider renders nothing (UnmappedProvider).

apps/web/components/atoms/Icon.tsx.empty: Icon renders one named glyph and takes no collection; the detector matched the .map( over name segments in resolveIconName. An unknown name renders nothing, which Icon.test.tsx covers.
apps/web/components/atoms/Icon.tsx.partial: Icon's only data input is name; ariaLabel, ariaHidden, size and className are accessibility and presentation options with defaults, so a glyph is either drawn whole or not at all.
apps/web/components/atoms/Icon.tsx.long-content: Icon lays out no text; its only other string input, ariaLabel, is announced rather than rendered, so there is no content to overflow.
apps/web/components/atoms/Icon.tsx.permission-denied: Icon has no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='img' on a labelled glyph.

apps/web/components/atoms/ImageWithFallb.partial: ImageWithFallback renders exactly one image or one placeholder: a source is present, absent (EmptySource) or broken (ErrorBrokenSource); its other optional props are styling and an error callback, so nothing can be partially present.
apps/web/components/atoms/ImageWithFallb.long-content: It lays out no text; alt is the accessible name of the image or placeholder rather than rendered copy, so there is no content to overflow.
apps/web/components/atoms/ImageWithFallb.permission-denied: It only draws an image or a placeholder glyph and has no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='img' on the labelled placeholder.
apps/web/components/atoms/ImageWithFallb.rtl-overflow: It renders no text and uses no inline-direction classes: the placeholder glyph is centered with flex inside a full-size or inset-0 box, so dir='rtl' renders it the same.

apps/web/components/atoms/InlineIconButt.partial: InlineIconButton draws one icon control from its required icon child and accessible name; its optional props (className, fadeOnParentHover, size, href and native button or anchor attributes) are styling, behaviour and wiring with defaults, so no data can be partially present.
apps/web/components/atoms/InlineIconButt.long-content: It lays out no visible text: every caller passes one icon glyph (at most with an sr-only word) and the name lives in aria-label, so there is no content to overflow; the detector matched the children and label props.
apps/web/components/atoms/InlineIconButt.rtl-overflow: It renders one centred icon in a fixed square with symmetric padding and no inline-direction classes, so dir='rtl' renders it the same and there is no text to overflow.

apps/web/components/atoms/InvisibleTurns.loading: While Cloudflare's script loads, InvisibleTurnstile renders only an off-screen, aria-hidden mount and reports status 'loading' to its owning form through onStateChange; Storybook bypasses the vendor script (it would need the network), so InvisibleTurnstile.test.tsx covers the load and its timeout.
apps/web/components/atoms/InvisibleTurns.error: InvisibleTurnstile shows no error UI of its own: a failed script load or challenge clears the token and reports status 'error' with its message through onStateChange for the owning form to show, which InvisibleTurnstile.test.tsx covers without loading the vendor script.
apps/web/components/atoms/InvisibleTurns.partial: InvisibleTurnstile takes no display data; its optional props are the onStateChange callback and the resetSignal counter, and the detector counted the optional message field of the state it reports, so nothing can be partially present.
apps/web/components/atoms/InvisibleTurns.long-content: InvisibleTurnstile renders no caller text; its only string is the fixed aria-label 'Security Verification', and the status messages it reports go to the owning form (the detector matched message and label).
apps/web/components/atoms/InvisibleTurns.offline: InvisibleTurnstile never fetches or mutates itself; losing the connection reaches it only as the vendor script failing or timing out, which it reports as status 'error' or 'timeout' through onStateChange, as InvisibleTurnstile.test.tsx covers.
apps/web/components/atoms/InvisibleTurns.rtl-overflow: InvisibleTurnstile renders no text of its own; the challenge panel is Cloudflare's iframe, which follows the browser locale, and its status messages are shown by the owning form (the detector matched message and label).

apps/web/components/atoms/Logo.tsx.empty: Logo draws the fixed Jovie wordmark or mark and takes no collection; the detector matched the .map( over the wordmark's own glyph paths from wordmarkGeometry, which always holds the five letters, so there is nothing that can be empty.
apps/web/components/atoms/Logo.tsx.permission-denied: Logo only draws the brand wordmark or mark and has no permission input or gated action; the detector matched role='img' on the labelled svg.

apps/web/components/atoms/LogoLink.tsx.empty: LogoLink always renders the Jovie mark and takes no collection; the detector matched the items-center class.

apps/web/components/atoms/ReleaseArtwork.long-content: ReleaseArtworkThumb paints no text: the release title is only the image alt and a screen-reader label on the fallback inside a fixed square, so a long title cannot overflow it.

apps/web/components/atoms/SocialIcon.tsx.long-content: SocialIcon draws one fixed 24x24 glyph and lays out no text; its only string input, aria-label, is announced rather than rendered, so there is no content to overflow.
apps/web/components/atoms/SocialIcon.tsx.permission-denied: SocialIcon only draws a platform glyph and has no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='img' on the labelled svg.

apps/web/components/atoms/VerifiedBadge..partial: VerifiedBadge takes no data; its only optional props are size and className, both styling with defaults, and its glyph and accessible name are fixed, so nothing can be partially present.
apps/web/components/atoms/VerifiedBadge..permission-denied: VerifiedBadge is a static verification mark with no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='img' on its wrapper.

apps/web/components/features/alerts/Unpu.offline: The copy and its fallback never fetch; the alert sign-up it hosts, AlertGrowthLanding, owns the subscribe request and its network error. The detector matched the loading test id on the Suspense fallback (Loading).
apps/web/components/features/alerts/Unpu.permission-denied: It is a public opt-in with no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='status' on the loading fallback.

apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthBr.empty: AuthBrandPanel renders one static product frame and an optional headline block and takes no collection; the detector matched 'releases' in the frame's scenario id. Hidden text is the TextHidden story.

apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthOf.permission-denied: The recap has no permission input or gated action; the detector matched the pricing plan. Sign-in for an existing subscriber is shown by SignInContinue.

apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthPr.empty: The only product caller that renders a provider group, AuthShell, renders it only when at least one provider is enabled and otherwise leads with the email form (AuthShell.test.tsx, 'leads with the email form when no provider is enabled'); AuthProviderButtonSlots has no other caller, so an empty group never renders.

apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthSh.empty: Providers come from the hardcoded allowlist in lib/auth/oauth-providers.ts (Google and Apple always on), so the zero-provider email-only branch is a fail-safe no real render reaches and a story cannot reach without mocking that module; AuthShell.test.tsx covers it by mocking the allowlist.
apps/web/components/features/auth/AuthSh.permission-denied: AuthShell has no permission input or gated action; the detector matched the offer plan. A provider that denies consent returns to the page with ?error=, which SignInOauthErrorBanner on the sign-in page classifies outside this shell.

apps/web/components/features/auth/Authen.loading: While the Better Auth session is still pending the guard deliberately keeps rendering its children unchanged (JOV-6450) and draws no spinner or skeleton of its own, so the loading frame is the SignedOut story; the detector matched 'pending' in a comment.
apps/web/components/features/auth/Authen.error: The guard has no error UI: it only decides between passing its children through and returning null while it redirects. The detector matched 'error' in comments about hydration error #418 and duplicate error banners.
apps/web/components/features/auth/Authen.long-content: The guard renders no box or text of its own; it passes its children through unchanged, so any long content belongs to and is shown by the child surface's stories.
apps/web/components/features/auth/Authen.offline: The guard never fetches or mutates; it reads the session from useAuthSafe and the session cookie and calls router.replace, so lost connectivity can only leave the children rendered, which the SignedOut story shows.
apps/web/components/features/auth/Authen.rtl-overflow: The guard renders no box or text of its own and passes its children through unchanged, so direction and overflow belong to the child surface.

apps/web/components/features/auth/Google.loading: GoogleOneTap renders no markup; the One Tap prompt is drawn in Google-owned chrome, and the detector matched 'pending' in the comment about a pending sign-in provider.
apps/web/components/features/auth/Google.error: GoogleOneTap renders no markup; a dismissed, cooled-down or unauthorized prompt is swallowed by design so the provider buttons stay the path, which GoogleOneTap.test.tsx covers.
apps/web/components/features/auth/Google.offline: GoogleOneTap renders no markup and fetches nothing itself; without a connection Google Identity Services simply shows no prompt and the rejection is swallowed, as GoogleOneTap.test.tsx covers.
apps/web/components/features/auth/Google.permission-denied: GoogleOneTap has no gated action or permission input; the detector matched 'Plan decision' and 'gated' in its doc comment about the client-id gate.

apps/web/components/features/auth/atoms/.permission-denied: FormError only shows a caller's validation message and has no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='alert'.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/N.offline: It never fetches or mutates: it renders null and only reports readiness once the caller's ready flag flips (LoadingDestinationData shows it held). apps/web/components/features/dashboard/d.offline: InboxAttentionLink never fetches or mutates; it renders the pending count its owner passes, and with no connection that count stays unloaded, which the Partial story shows.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/d.permission-denied: InboxAttentionLink links to the signed-in Inbox that every account can open and has no gated action; a viewer who cannot reach the dashboard never sees the app rail.

apps/web/components/features/feedback/Pa.empty: PageErrorState renders one title, one message and one retry action and takes no collection; the detector matched the items-center utility class.

apps/web/components/features/landing/Lan.partial: LandingCTAButton draws one link from its required href, label, eventName and section; its optional props (variant, className, testId) are styling and test wiring with defaults, so no data can be partially present.

apps/web/components/features/onboarding/.empty: OnboardingSecurityCheckRecovery always renders one fixed heading, one status line and the retry button, and never a collection; the detector matched the items-start and items-center classes.

apps/web/components/features/pricing/Mar.empty: Plans are the three checked-in public plans filtered by NEXT_PUBLIC_MARKETING_VISIBLE_PLANS, and a filter naming no known plan falls back to all three, so the card list cannot be empty. apps/web/components/features/pricing/Mar.permission-denied: Public pricing has no gated action: every visitor sees every visible plan and its CTA. The detector matched the word plan; entitlement checks happen after the CTA, in checkout.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Ali.error: Recovery returns null in every state; a failed, non-OK or malformed alias decision only leaves the visitor on the mode page, which has no pixels of its own to show. apps/web/components/features/profile/Cla.empty: ClaimBanner renders no collection: it always shows one ownership message and at most one CTA; the detector matched the items-center class. The no-CTA variant is PartialNoClaimAction.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.empty: The proof claim card renders no collection: one heading, one note and one CTA, all required props; the detector matched the items-start class.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.error: The tracker returns null; a refused beacon falls back to the tracking mutation and nothing is shown to the visitor, so there is no error state to render. ProfileViewTracker.certificate.test.tsx asserts the fallback and an axe-clean page.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Pro.error: The reporter returns null and swallows a failed web-vitals import or start so the profile keeps rendering; there is nothing to draw for the failure, and ProfileWebVitalsReporter.test.tsx asserts the swallowed failure with axe.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Pub.permission-denied: The fixture is a public profile with no gated action; claimed, owner and unclaimed only change the claim banner (Claimed, Unclaimed). The detector matched role: 'producer' in the release credit.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Sta.error: Every failure in a provider press (cookie or storage write, analytics, deep link) is caught and falls back to opening the provider URL in a new tab; the row has no error UI. The detector matched those catch blocks.

apps/web/components/features/profile/Sub.long-content: The banner's title and description are fixed copy with no props or user text, so its content cannot grow; the detector matched the Banner title and description props.

apps/web/components/features/profile/art.long-content: BirthdayInput always renders exactly eight single-digit boxes (MM/DD/YYYY) under fixed Month, Day and Year labels; it takes no caller text, and useSegmentedInput strips non-digits and drops anything past the eighth digit, which BirthdayInput.test.tsx covers, so nothing can grow.

apps/web/components/features/profile/art.long-content: The skeleton renders no caller text: its title and body are fixed non-breaking spaces and the consent line is invisible, so there is no content that can run long.
apps/web/components/features/profile/art.offline: The skeleton never fetches; it stands in while the visitor's assignment resolves, and the live form that replaces it reports connectivity.

apps/web/components/features/release/Act.error: ActionDial never fetches or mutates; its only catch blocks guard localStorage for the first-use hint, and blocked storage still shows the hint, which ActionDial.test.tsx covers ('survives blocked storage').

apps/web/components/features/release/Alb.error: The menu has no error UI: a failed download falls back to opening the artwork URL in a new tab, and AlbumArtworkContextMenu.test.tsx asserts that fallback.

apps/web/components/features/release/Sma.empty: The skeleton draws a fixed five provider rows from a constant key list and takes no props, so there is no collection that can be empty; the detector matched that .map(.

apps/web/components/features/teleprompte.empty: Renders one fixed message for one camera error and no collection; the detector matched the items-start layout class.

packages/ui/atoms/common-dropdown-render.offline: The renderer never fetches or submits: it draws the search field and the rows its owner passes, and a submenu shows loading only when the caller sets isLoading (LoadingItems), so lost connectivity reaches it only as caller state.
packages/ui/atoms/common-dropdown-render.permission-denied: The renderer has no permission input or gated action; the detector matched role='menuitem' on the loading and empty rows. A caller that withholds a submenu passes disabled, which Radix renders as an inert trigger.

packages/ui/atoms/common-dropdown.tsx.offline: CommonDropdown renders caller-supplied items and never fetches or submits; isLoading is a caller flag, so lost connectivity can only reach it as the existing LoadingState or EmptyState stories.

packages/ui/atoms/composite-field.tsx.offline: CompositeField is a layout and focus-ring container that never submits or fetches ("submit" appears only in its doc comment); the form that owns its input and button reports offline.

packages/ui/atoms/icon-button.tsx.partial: IconButton renders a single glyph with a required accessible label and carries no data payload; its optional props (variant, size, the ariaLabel alias) are presentation defaults, so nothing can be partially present.

packages/ui/atoms/inline-offline.tsx.empty: InlineOfflineNotice renders no collection: it always shows one message (defaulting to the offline copy) plus an optional retry, so it has no empty-data state of its own.
packages/ui/atoms/inline-offline.tsx.permission-denied: The notice only reports lost connectivity and offers a retry; it has no permission input or gated action, and the detector matched role='status'.

packages/ui/atoms/input.tsx.offline: Input never fetches or submits; it only renders the loading/pending flags its owner passes in, so connectivity is shown by the owning form, not the input.

packages/ui/atoms/kbd.tsx.empty: Kbd renders the single key name its caller passes and never a collection; the detector matched the items-center utility class, and a keycap with no key is not a state any caller renders.

packages/ui/atoms/label.tsx.empty: Label has no data list; it renders exactly the text it is given (the detector matched the items-center class), so there is no empty state distinct from rendering nothing.
packages/ui/atoms/label.tsx.partial: Label's optional props (required, disabled, variant) are presentation flags, not data that can arrive partially; every combination is already shown in Default, Required, Variants and Disabled.

packages/ui/atoms/link.tsx.partial: Link renders one label slot; its optional props (variant, active, visited, disabled, touchTarget, reserveLabel) are presentation flags with defaults, and the not-yet-arrived label case is shown by the EmptyStreamedLabel story.

packages/ui/atoms/progress.tsx.permission-denied: ProgressBar only reports completion of an upload or import and has no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='progressbar'.

packages/ui/atoms/searchable-submenu.tsx.offline: SearchableSubmenu and SearchableList filter caller-supplied sections in memory and never fetch; isLoading is a caller flag, so lost connectivity can only reach them as the existing LoadingNestedMenu or Empty stories.

packages/ui/atoms/segment-control.tsx.loading: SegmentControl is a controlled, synchronous view switch with no async work; the 'pending' match is a comment on Tabs.Trigger's disabled appearance, and owners disable an option while its view loads (PartialAvailability story).
packages/ui/atoms/segment-control.tsx.empty: options is an author-defined list of mutually exclusive views and callers never render the control without them; an empty tablist would be invalid ARIA (aria-required-children), so it is not a supported state.
packages/ui/atoms/segment-control.tsx.offline: SegmentControl never fetches or mutates; switching views is local state owned by the caller, so connectivity cannot change its rendering (the detector matched the word 'pending').

packages/ui/atoms/simple-tooltip.tsx.partial: SimpleTooltip takes one required content node plus presentation defaults (side, sideOffset, showArrow, contentVariant, className); it owns no data that could be partially present.

packages/ui/atoms/skeleton.tsx.empty: A skeleton stands in for content that has not arrived and holds no data; line counts below 1 clamp to one placeholder line, so an empty result is the owner's empty state, which replaces the skeleton.
packages/ui/atoms/skeleton.tsx.offline: Skeleton never fetches; when the owner's request fails offline it replaces the placeholder with InlineOfflineNotice instead of leaving the shimmer running.
packages/ui/atoms/skeleton.tsx.permission-denied: Skeleton is an aria-hidden layout placeholder with no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='status' on the LoadingSkeleton owner.

packages/ui/atoms/spinner.tsx.empty: Spinner draws a single in-flight indicator with no data or collection to be empty; the detector matched the word 'list' in its usage comment.
packages/ui/atoms/spinner.tsx.partial: Spinner has no data that can arrive in part: it is one indeterminate ring, and omitted props only fall back to the md size, primary tone and 'Loading' label.
packages/ui/atoms/spinner.tsx.offline: Spinner only shows that an action is in flight; whether that action is offline is decided by its owner, which swaps the spinner for InlineOfflineNotice.
packages/ui/atoms/spinner.tsx.permission-denied: Spinner has no gated action or permission input; the detector matched role='status' on its live region.

packages/ui/atoms/status-glyph.tsx.offline: StatusGlyph renders only the states in STATUS_GLYPH_STATES and has no connectivity input; an owner maps an offline or interrupted operation onto one of them (resolveOperationStatus yields unknown), shown in the Empty and OperationStates stories.
packages/ui/atoms/status-glyph.tsx.permission-denied: StatusGlyph has no permission input; a denied operation resolves to the cancelled glyph shown in OperationStates, and the detector matched role='img'.

packages/ui/atoms/switch.tsx.empty: Switch is a boolean control that always holds on or off, so it has no empty value (the detector matched the items-center class); the off state is shown in Default.
packages/ui/atoms/switch.tsx.partial: Switch takes no data; its optional props (stateStyling, thumbClassName, thumbChildren, thumbTranslation) are owner styling hooks, so there is no partially loaded state to render.

packages/ui/atoms/textarea.tsx.offline: Textarea never fetches or submits; its only async signal is the pending validationState its owner passes in, so the owning form shows offline status.

packages/ui/atoms/tooltip.tsx.empty: TooltipContent only renders caller-supplied children and owns no data or collection; callers omit the Tooltip rather than open an empty one, and the detector matched the items-center utility class.
packages/ui/atoms/tooltip.tsx.partial: Tooltip is a presentational overlay for caller content; its optional props (contentVariant, showArrow, testId, tone) are styling flags with defaults, so there is no partially-present data.

packages/ui/confirm-dialog.tsx.offline: ConfirmDialog never fetches; it awaits the caller's onConfirm, so a request that fails offline surfaces as the ErrorState story's retry alert and connectivity is owned by the caller.
packages/ui/confirm-dialog.tsx.permission-denied: ConfirmDialog has no role, permission or entitlement logic (the detector matched role='alert' on its error message); callers decide access before opening it, and a blocked confirm is the existing ConfirmationRequired story.
